label: Greenhouse control
info:
Greenhouse climate control: closes the loop from readings to actuators.

- sensors/<zone>/temperature   → fan rule   (on at TEMP_HIGH, off TEMP_HYSTERESIS below)
- sensors/<zone>/soil_moisture → valve rule (open at SOIL_LOW, close at SOIL_HIGH)
- actuators/<zone>/<actuator>/mode (auto | on | off, retained) → manual override
- every 5 s → valve watchdog (STALE_AFTER, VALVE_MAX_RUN, VALVE_LOCKOUT)

Commands go to actuators/<zone>/<actuator>/set, retained, as
{"state": "on", "mode": "auto", "reason": "...", "at": "<ISO time>"}.
Thresholds come from .env (docker compose up -d node-red after a change).
Telegraf stores the readings and the commands in InfluxDB; this flow only decides.
